# uses scale

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usesScale`](gmeow-usesScale.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usesScale>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The score scale a rubric or criterion uses. Domain-free (rubric-level default, criterion-level override — the holder is whatever points here); functional: one scale per holder, the [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md) convention.
